AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 16, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685; PASSCODE: 784059 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM
OR UNDER ORAL COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR
CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-
agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957(a):
  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE § 54956.9(d)(2) – Significant Exposure to Litigation in one case.

RECESS

REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Jim Parker
  Executive Director of Regional Transportation

FLAG SALUTE
  Alfonzo Sanchez
  Norwalk Transit Coach Operator

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
  City Council to recognize Distinguished Coach Operators of the Year and Safe Driver Awards.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  The Whole Child Annual Report.

  3.  Norwalk Arts & Sports Complex Gym Ribbon Cutting.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of
  January 28 and February 2, 2021. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period January 10, 2021 –
   January 23, 2021, in the total amount of $903,530.53. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period of
  January 28, 2021 – February 10, 2021, in the total amount of $2,937,115.29. 640

  Report

  4.  CLAIM AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claim filed by Reyes Valadez.
  830-22

  Report

  5.  FEDERAL TRANSIT ADMINISTRATION CERTIFICATIONS AND ASSURANCES FOR FEDERAL
  FISCAL YEAR 2021 – Staff recommends City Council authorize the Executive Director of Regional
  Transportation to execute the Fiscal Year 2021 Certifications and Assurances Federal Transit
  Administration Assistance Programs/Affirmation of Applicant, file grant application(s) on behalf of the
  City and execute a grant agreement(s); in concurrence with and execution of the Affirmation of
  Applicant’s Attorney Certification by the City Attorney. 1105-01

  Report

  6.  AUTHORIZATION TO EXECUTE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) FOR ALLOCATION
  OF MEASURE R FUNDS FOR REGIONAL CLEAN FUEL BUS CAPITAL (FACILITIES AND ROLLING
  STOCK) PROGRAM - Staff recommends City Council approve the MOU to Allocate Measure R Funds
  for Regional Clean Fuel Bus Capital Facilities and Rolling Stock, and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the MOU on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

  7.  AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 5 AND TERM EXTENSION - PARATRANSIT USER SIDE SUBSIDY
  TRANSPORTATION PROGRAM - Staff recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 5 with
  Fiesta Taxi Cooperative, Inc. extending the term through June 30, 2021 to provide the Paratransit User
  Side Subsidy Transportation Program on a month-to-month basis at the current contractual rate; and
  authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 5, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney. 1120-07

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  8.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

PUBLIC HEARING

  9.  PUBLIC HEARING - RESOLUTION NO. 21-04 – SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL
  YEAR 2019/20 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN AND RESOLUTION NO. 21-05 – BUDGET AMENDMENT –
  RECEIPT OF COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT CORONAVIRUS RESPONSE FUNDS
  AND AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 1 – PROFESSIONAL SERVICES FOR PLANNING AND
  UTILIZATION OF COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT CARES ACT FUNDS – Staff
  recommends City Council:

  a.  consider adopting Resolution No. 21-04, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF NORWALK APPROVING A SUBSTANTIAL AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20
  ANNUAL ACTION PLAN, APPLICATION OF CARES ACT FUNDS, AND IMPLEMENTATION OF
  CDBG-CV WAIVERS AND CDBG-CV3 PROGRAM FUNDS, and

  b.  consider adopting Resolution No. 21-05, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF NORWALK APPROVING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CARES ACT FUNDS FROM THE
   DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, in the amount of $850,708.

  c.  approve Amendment No. 1 to the agreement with Michael Baker International, Inc. dated May 19,
  2020 to provide on-call CDBG professional services in an amount not to exceed $300,141; and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any additional amendments provided
  there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.
  REPORT

  Report

  10. RESOLUTION NO. 21-06 – FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 SECOND QUARTER BUDGET REVIEW AND
  REVISIONS - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-06, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING AMENDMENTS TO THE FISCAL YEAR
  2020/21 BUDGET. 610

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated February 12, 2021.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
